title: A store that had a tunnel with a friendly monster at the bottom
content: I remember this dream where i was a kid and saw this store i when i went in the store there was every thing i grabbed a cola and and went to get ice cream and when went to the freezer there was this hole i looked to my left and to the right there was nobody and when in there it was long slide and i passed out and i was in this pitch black box and there was this monster he was friendly the monster was black and big also had a tail and had a smile on his face always kind and he was like torel from undertale(and i think this dream is about that) so when i went there there was nobody me and that monster and also that monster can grant wishes but its not like a genie with 3 wishes he gave me unlimited wishes you can wish for anything i cant remember what i wished for but at the end i told him i wanted to go back and told me okay and also come back tomorrow with a smile he send me back again and also passed out i woke up and went home. Next day i went back slided and there was kids there was 4-5 kids down there and told me "welcome back my friend" i spent there best time and came back but i remember him getting evil and becoming a vilan and the dream ended. And also while ago i dreamed the same dream and he looked at me and went happy and said "i missed you" and hugged him yeah a weird dream but my personal best (i wish i dreamed this again)
